016 *
017 * U = units, E = equipment, I= installations, SI = signals intelligence (SIGINT), SO = stability operations, EU = EMS units, EEI = EMS equipment and incidents, EI =
018 * EMS installations.
019 * @author michael.spinelli
020 */

371    public static ArrayList<Integer> GetModifierList()
372    {
373        ArrayList<Integer> list = new ArrayList<Integer>();
374
375        //list.add(ModifierType.A_SYMBOL_ICON);//graphical, feeds off of symbol code, SIDC positions 3, 5-10
376        //list.add(ModifierType.B_ECHELON);//graphical, feeds off of symbol code, SIDC positions 11-12
377        list.add(C_QUANTITY);
378        //list.add(D_TASK_FORCE_INDICATOR);//graphical, feeds off of symbol code, SIDC positions 11-12
379        //list.add(E_FRAME_SHAPE_MODIFIER);//symbol frame, feeds off of symbol code, SIDC positions 3-4
380        list.add(F_REINFORCED_REDUCED);//R = reinforced, D = reduced, RD = reinforced and reduced
381        list.add(G_STAFF_COMMENTS);
382        list.add(H_ADDITIONAL_INFO_1);
383        list.add(H1_ADDITIONAL_INFO_2);
384        list.add(H2_ADDITIONAL_INFO_3);
385        list.add(J_EVALUATION_RATING);
386        list.add(K_COMBAT_EFFECTIVENESS);
387        list.add(L_SIGNATURE_EQUIP);
388        list.add(M_HIGHER_FORMATION);
389        list.add(N_HOSTILE);
390        list.add(P_IFF_SIF);
391        list.add(Q_DIRECTION_OF_MOVEMENT);//number in mils
392        //list.add(R_MOBILITY_INDICATOR);//graphical, feeds off of symbol code, SIDC positions 11-12
393        list.add(R2_SIGNIT_MOBILITY_INDICATOR);
394        //list.add(S_HQ_STAFF_OR_OFFSET_INDICATOR);//graphical, feeds off of symbol code, SIDC positions 11-12
395        list.add(T_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_1);
396        list.add(T1_UNIQUE_DESIGNATION_2);
397        list.add(V_EQUIP_TYPE);
398        list.add(W_DTG_1);
399        list.add(W1_DTG_2);
400        list.add(X_ALTITUDE_DEPTH);
401        list.add(Y_LOCATION);
402        list.add(Z_SPEED);
403
404        list.add(AA_SPECIAL_C2_HQ);
405        //list.add(AB_FEINT_DUMMY_INDICATOR);//graphical, feeds off of symbol code, SIDC positions 11-12
406        //list.add(AC_INSTALLATION);//graphical, feeds off of symbol code, SIDC positions 11-12
407        list.add(AD_PLATFORM_TYPE);
408        list.add(AE_EQUIPMENT_TEARDOWN_TIME);
409        list.add(AF_COMMON_IDENTIFIER);
410        list.add(AG_AUX_EQUIP_INDICATOR);
411        list.add(AH_AREA_OF_UNCERTAINTY);
412        list.add(AI_DEAD_RECKONING_TRAILER);
413        list.add(AJ_SPEED_LEADER);
414        list.add(AK_PAIRING_LINE);
415        //list.add(AL_OPERATIONAL_CONDITION);//2525C ////graphical, feeds off of symbol code, SIDC positions 4
416        list.add(AO_ENGAGEMENT_BAR);//2525C
417
418
419
420        return list;
421    }

619    /**
620     * go from "T" or "T1" to integer constant values 9 and 10
621     * @param modLetter
622     * @return
623     */
624    public static int getModifierKey(String modLetter) {
625        switch (modLetter) {
626            case "A":
627                return A_SYMBOL_ICON;
628            case "B":
629                return B_ECHELON;
630            case "C":
631                return C_QUANTITY;
632            case "D":
633                return D_TASK_FORCE_INDICATOR;
634            case "E":
635                return E_FRAME_SHAPE_MODIFIER;
636            case "F":
